guidelines.title: RoValra 使用條款
guidelines.message:
使用 RoValra 即表示您同意遵守我們的使用條款。違反這些規則可能會導致您無法存取某些功能，包括狀態氣泡和代名詞。

重點：
• 您不准引導使用者離開平台。
• 您不准進行任何不當行為。
• 您不准違反 Roblox 使用條件。

若要瞭解更多資訊，請訪問 rovalra.com/tou.

review.requestMessage:
看來您從 RoValra 那裡獲得了價值！
 您能否為我們的擴充功能留下評分？
 這有助於維持 RoValra 的免費使用，讓所有人都能無需付費使用功能。
review.donationMessage:
執行地區選擇器等功能並非免費，RoValra 完全依賴捐款來支付這些費用。

捐贈有助於我們維持伺服器執行，從而使此類功能能夠繼續免費供所有人使用。
review.donationTitle: 想幫助支援 RoValra 嗎？

info.title: RoValra Information!
info.desc1: RoValra is an extension that's trying to make basic quality-of-life features free and accessible to everyone by making everything completely open-source.
info.desc2: Some free features still rely on RoValra servers and cost money to run.
info.desc3: Supporter donations help cover those costs, letting RoValra keep more features free for everyone while continuing to improve over time. <icon style="color:#c13ad9" filled>heart</icon>
info.desc4: RoValra is a passion project and has always been one.
info.suggestions: If you have any feature suggestions please let me know in my Discord server or via GitHub
info.bugs: If you find any bugs let me know in my Discord server or via GitHub
info.review: If you like this extension please consider leaving a review, it helps a lot heart
